name: A comet loops through a dotted flow field
looks: A dark field of faint dots arranged along soft flow-lines sits still, then a comet of coloured dots traces a looping path through it, its tail tapering off in size and opacity as it goes, reading as a single idea moving through a system of many.
build: Background dots are static, placed along a precomputed vector-flow pattern at very low opacity. The comet is a chain of particles following a looping bezier/figure-8 path, each particle spawned a few frames behind the one before it and fading/shrinking with age so the tail reads as a trail, not a train of identical dots.
sound: A soft whoosh that rises and falls with the comet's speed around the loop, nothing under the static background.
prompt: Over a dark field of faint dots arranged along soft flow-lines, trace a looping comet of coloured dots through it, its tail tapering off in size and opacity as it travels, so a single idea reads as moving purposefully through a larger, quieter system.
